thread:
sara - eng-platform: Heads-up — SRE keeps hitting a wall when debugging latency spikes because anonymized request logs don't carry enough provenance. can we design a minimal provenance bundle that preserves privacy but helps trace incidents?

jamal - eng-ml: 100% agree. We need route/model/version + some stable pseudonym so we can correlate sequences without revealing tenant.

priya - devex: Important to keep this friendly for the Console — ops should be able to toggle provenance fields per-route when rolling out. UI mock: checkbox 'attach lightweight provenance (no PII)'; slider for sample rate.

alex - eng-sre: Key constraints from oncall: 1) No raw PII in regular logs; 2) low overhead on p99 latency; 3) strong audit trail if someone needs de-anonymization for legal/bug reasons.

maria - legal: From a compliance POV reversible identifiers are a big red flag unless access is auditable + gated. Prefer deterministic salted hashes with strong key management; reversible only via a documented breakglass process.

jamal - eng-ml: Proposal sketch: include these provenance fields in sampled telemetry/events:  - tenant_hash: HMAC_SHA256(tenant_id, env_key_id)  - route: canonical route string  - model: served_model:version  - sample_bucket: small integer (0..255)  - redact_profile: version id  - provenance_version: semver  This keeps raw tenant_id out of logs but lets us correlate.

sara - eng-platform: Example event envelope we discussed (for visibility):
```json
{"event_id":"...","tenant_hash":"hmac:xxxx","route":"/v1/chat/completions","model":"redwood-3b:2026-02-01","sample_bucket":42,"redact_profile":"rp-v2","provenance_version":"1.0","payload_meta":"size=512 tokens"}
```

alex - eng-sre: Two operational notes: 1) Salt rotate: we must keep mapping ephemeral for at least 30d to trace incidents across rotations; 2) storing mapping = PII-equivalent, so treat like audit logs behind KMS/HSM and short TTL.

maria - legal: Agree on TTL but need to capture who requested a mapping and why. Every de-anonymization must write an immutable audit record: requester, reason, ticket id.

priya - devex: Console UX idea: per-route provenance opt-in (default off). If on, show a provenance summary on the route page: fields emitted, sample rate, retention days. Add a 'breakglass request' button that opens a recorded workflow for legal + infra approvals.

jamal - eng-ml: For debugging ML regressions we sometimes need deterministic pseudonymization across services (so the same tenant_hash appears in metrics and logs). HMAC with environment-scoped key works, but we must ensure cross-region compatibility: either replicate key material or include a key-rotation tag in tenant_hash so we can join on (tenant_hash, key_tag).

sara - eng-platform: Performance: canonicalizing and HMAC-ing per-request needs benchmarking. We could do it in the ingress sidecar (C++) with hardware crypto, or batch-produce tenant_hash in the request router before fan-out. Also allow precomputed tenant_hash for dedicated/private customers who bring their own hash.

alex - eng-sre: Sampling policy tie-ins: prefer sampling by route + error rate + quota class. e.g., 1% baseline sample of requests, jump to 100% for routes with elevated error rate for 10m. That gives SRE the traces they need without large volume.

jamal - eng-ml: Another idea: add a short provenance fingerprint for sequence correlation: pf = prefix of sha256(tenant_hash || request_trace_id) length 8. Low collision risk and not reversible.

priya - devex: Console representation for canary: on rollout modal include 'Enable provenance sampling' with a numeric percent and a note about retention. Also show a small telemetry bar: bytes/sec and p99 overhead estimate.

maria - legal: We need to document risk: re-identification via correlation of metadata (model, route, timestamps). Recommend privacy review for any provenance changes and a short mitigation checklist in the RFC.

sara - eng-platform: Proposed incremental plan: 1) RFC with schema + KMS requirements + retention + audit flow (this week) 2) lightweight canary — emit immutable provenance fields (non-reversible tenant_hash, route, model, sample_bucket, provenance_version) at 1% of production for 2 weeks 3) measure p50/p99 overhead, collision rates, and debug value 4) if good, add per-route Console toggle + 1% -> 10% phased rollout 5) separate opt-in canary for reversible breakglass with legal approvals and HSM-backed mapping for 30d TTL.

alex - eng-sre: +1 to that plan. I'll add runbook updates for breakglass and contain a playbook for suspicious access.

jamal - eng-ml: Also add a telemetry dashboard panel that shows provenance-enabled request fraction by route and top routes using provenance so we can cost it.

priya - devex: I'll mock the Console modal and provenance panel tomorrow. Will include copy for legal/ops.

maria - legal: I'll prepare the conditional approval language for breakglass and sample audit log template.

telemetry-bot: automated-snapshot: provenance-canary-0.01 enabled on prod at 2026-03-20T14:00Z, sample_count=12, avg_payload_overhead=0.8%

sara - eng-platform: Action items summary: 1) jamal write RFC with schema + crypto/key-rotation details 2) alex update runbooks + propose HSM boundaries 3) priya Console mocks + UX copy 4) maria legal approval draft 5) schedule 1% canary after RFC review. Anyone object?

jamal - eng-ml: No objections from me. I'll start the RFC.

alex - eng-sre: None.

priya - devex: 👍 will have mocks by EOD.

maria - legal: No objections; need RFC before breakglass enablement.

sara - eng-platform: Sweet. If we can get RFC + mocks this week we can spin up the 1% probe next Tue. :thumbsup:

(react: :thumbsup: from jamal, alex, priya)
